questions.question: Which UNSW GlobalProtect VPN connection profile is for Faculty support?
questions.answer: hostingvpn-portal.unsw.edu.au.

questions.question: Which three MFA options are listed for UNSW GlobalProtect sign-in?
questions.answer: Microsoft Authenticator, a third-party mobile authenticator, or a hardware token.

questions.question: What two computer security prerequisites does the UNSW guide give for connecting to GlobalProtect?
questions.answer: Use a supported antivirus client and install the latest security patches.

questions.question: How many simultaneous connections does the UNSW VPN permit for one account?
After connecting to the Deerfield VPN, what desktop icon opens mapped drives and how do you disconnect the VPN?
questions.answer: Double-click Map My Drives. Click the Globe icon and choose Disconnect.

questions.question: How many VPN tickets did Deerfield IT resolve last calendar month?
How many working MFA methods does FLCC require for self-service password reset, and which form should people use if they do not meet that requirement?
questions.answer: Two working MFA methods. Use the Account Activation and Password Recovery form.

questions.question: What minimum password length does the FLCC self-service guide require, and what does it require for digits and special characters?
questions.answer: At least 14 characters, including at least one number and one special character.

questions.question: How many password reset tickets did the FLCC helpdesk close in the previous calendar month?
When adding a personal email as a Surrey reset method, what address do you enter and what do you do with the code sent there?
questions.answer: Enter a personal email address, then enter the verification code in the form.

questions.question: How many days does Surrey keep a self-service password reset event in its audit logs?
Which link in the Winthrop Microsoft login window starts password recovery?
questions.answer: Click Forgot my password at the bottom of the login window.

questions.question: Which network options does the Houston guide list for accessing PaperCut from a personal device?
questions.answer: UHGuest Wi-Fi, UHSecure Wi-Fi, or UH VPN.

questions.question: How long does an unreleased print job stay in the University of Houston release queue?
questions.answer: Four hours before it is purged.

questions.question: What is the exact serial number of the spare printer kept in the University of Houston print stockroom?
How does a Senate House Library member start registering a card for printing?
questions.answer: Log into the catalogue, enter name and membership number, and tick the option to create a printing and copying account.

questions.question: What does the Senate House Library guide say to do when Secure AirPrint is missing from the Add dialog?
questions.answer: Close the Add dialog, disconnect and reconnect to the network, try again, and contact a library reception desk if it remains unavailable.

questions.question: Where do I select an online print-credit top-up, and does Senate House Library provide a receipt for online payment?
questions.answer: Choose Add Credit. Receipts are not provided for online payment.

questions.question: What SSID and encryption type does the Otago Mac guide list for its eduroam setup?
questions.answer: SSID eduroam and AES-CCMP encryption.

questions.question: What browser test does the Otago Mac eduroam guide recommend, and how should you retry if that check fails?
questions.answer: Open the University of Otago website. Disable and re-enable Wi-Fi if the check fails.

questions.question: What was the median eduroam throughput in Mbps at Otago last Tuesday?
Which authentication mode does Lakehead list in Windows Advanced settings for eduroam?
questions.answer: User Authentication.

questions.question: Which operating system is named as the prerequisite for the NOVA IMS eduroam configuration?
questions.answer: Windows 11.

questions.question: Which connection type does NOVA IMS tell Windows 11 users to choose before entering eduroam settings?
questions.answer: Manually connect to a wireless network.

questions.question: Where can SCSU Windows users browse or search for apps after opening Company Portal?
questions.answer: Choose Apps or use the search bar on the left-hand menu.

questions.question: How does SCSU Company Portal confirm an installation finished, and where can the installed app be found?
questions.answer: An Installed notice appears, and the app is listed in the Start Menu.

questions.question: How much did SCSU spend in total on desktop software licenses last financial year?
Where should SCSU Mac users open Self Service, and what account does the guide say to use if prompted?
questions.answer: Open it from the Dock or search in Finder, and use your SCSU email address and password if prompted.

questions.question: How should Texas A&M University-Corpus Christi users request software that is not automatically available in Software Center?
questions.answer: Submit an IT ticket at ITRequests@tamucc.edu.

questions.question: Which tab lists an application after installation is complete in the Texas A&M University-Corpus Christi Software Center guide?
questions.answer: Installed software.
